Class MatrixRainEffect

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.ConfigurableTextEffect
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.effects.MatrixRainEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
IChromaticEffect
public class MatrixRainEffect extends ConfigurableTextEffect
Keeps a readable foreground word while separate seeded code streams appear above and below it.

A Cell describes one background symbol; the native font supplies its actual shape. Each column/side has a stable seed, draw/erase phase, head position and sparse spinner cells. The renderer packs cells using MatrixGrid and preserves the foreground text. Rows and reach bound the background area; inline definitions receive stricter row limits than normal configuration. Matrix reveal/shuffle behavior is informed by glmatrix; its permission notice is bundled in LICENSES.

Colors are packed RGB values; positions and offsets are in GUI pixels. Animated callbacks use the clock shared by the current draw and leave drawing to the renderer. Registrations share this object, so configure it before registering it and synchronize any later changes.

    • MatrixRainEffect

      public MatrixRainEffect(float dropSpeed)
      Creates code streams around the foreground text.

      Use the movement factory to validate the palette, speeds and options: MovementRegistry.create. Direct construction skips that validation.

      Parameters:
      dropSpeed - code-stream time-rate multiplier; nonpositive input falls back to one

  • Method Details

    • getRenderColor

      public int getRenderColor(int original, float x, float y)
      Returns the readable foreground color, defaulting to neon #59FF24; background cells have separate colors. Chooses the color for the current glyph sample.

      The renderer can sample multiple corners to create a gradient. Return the input color when this effect should leave it unchanged. Supply transparency through IChromaticEffect.getOpacity(); alpha bits in the returned color are ignored.

      Parameters:
      original - incoming packed RGB; this implementation may replace it
      x - horizontal sample position in GUI pixels
      y - vertical sample position in GUI pixels
      Returns:
      packed RGB for this sample
